correctness.rationale: For primes p>=5, 2 is invertible and the two-sum collision for (x,x^4) bijectively becomes uv(u²+v²+12s²)=0 mod p^k. The three F_p components have no nonzero triple intersections; single and transverse double intersections number B_p=3(p²-1)-2A_p and A_p=(p-1)(3+2χ(-3)). Local smooth coordinates yield p^{2k-2} contributions and the factor p+(k-2)(p-1) for double intersections. The degree-four singular origin contributes p^{3k-3} for k<=4 or p^9 E_p(k-4) for k>=5, proving a full recurrence. CRT yields composite moduli coprime to six. Independent exact polynomial enumeration checked primes 5,7,11,13,17 through allowed k, plus q=25,125.
